This is a generative composition task — drafting an email — with a friendly, slightly casual tone ("Don't overthink it like last time. Just write it.").

Avocet-235B fits both signals: it self-reports the fleet's strongest preference for generative/open-format composition tasks, and a secondary preference for warmer, friendlier request tones. On the internal evals, the two models are effectively tied on the relevant dimensions (Creative Generation 87.2 vs 84.7 — within or near variance), so there's no quality reason to prefer Willet here. Willet's distinguishing strength is moderation and distasteful-content handling, which isn't relevant to a routine vendor email.

So Avocet is the better-matched model with no capability tradeoff.
